tools.name: list_engines
tools.description: Lists every AAJ marketing engine: its id, the question it answers, and its category. Engines cover unit economics, pipeline forecast, budget allocation, retention, A/B significance, SEO/GEO scoring, ad spend and pricing.

tools.name: describe_engine
tools.description: Shows one engine's input schema: required fields, units, alternative shapes, and a worked example. Engines reject bad input rather than guessing.

tools.name: run_engine
tools.description: Runs an AAJ engine and returns its verdict. Give `input` as an object of the engine's fields. Omit `input` to run the engine's built-in worked example. Engines are deterministic, offline, and validate their input — a wrong unit is reported as an error, not absorbed into a confident answer.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Finds AAJ marketing skills by the problem they solve — 'churn is rising', 'we're launching next month', 'not showing up in AI answers'. Returns matching methods and marks which have a runnable engine.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Returns the full method for one skill: when to use it, the steps, the quality bar, and how to run its engine if it has one.
